previous_baseline.note: The baseline and cited-literature run are not directly score-comparable because the latter excludes uncited paragraphs and separates prospective statements.

limitations: LLM claim extraction may miss or misclassify assertions.
Judgments use up to three passages selected from the sources attached to each exact claim, not full papers.
Uncited paragraphs are outside this run's evaluation scope, not verified.
Automated verdicts require human evaluation against reviewed labels.
